items.prompt:
Both Text A and Text B say the Amazon is a rainforest. They:
A) agree
B) disagree
C) are about different topics

Combining facts from two texts on one topic gives you:
A) a fuller understanding
B) fewer facts
C) nothing

steps: More info together. Key is A.

items.prompt:
'Integrate' information means to:
A) combine it
B) erase it
C) hide it

Text A says bats are flying mammals. Text B says bats use sound to find food. Using BOTH, a bat is:
A) a flying mammal that uses sound to find food
B) a bird
C) a fish
items.answer: A) a flying mammal that uses sound to find food

steps: Combine both facts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a flying mammal that uses sound to find food

items.prompt:
Text A tells HOW volcanoes form; Text B shows WHERE they are. Together they give:
A) a fuller picture (how and where)
B) the same one fact
C) nothing new
items.answer: A) a fuller picture (how and where)

steps: Different parts combine. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a fuller picture (how and where)

items.prompt:
Text A: a shark's size. Text B: a shark's diet. Reading both, you learn:
A) size and diet
B) only size
C) only the title

steps: Combine the facts. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Text A: 'Honeybees live in colonies.' Text B: 'Honeybees do a waggle dance to share where flowers are.' Using BOTH, the BEST summary is:
A) Honeybees live in colonies and communicate with a waggle dance to find flowers.
B) Honeybees are yellow.
C) Flowers smell nice.
items.answer: A) Honeybees live in colonies and communicate with a waggle dance to find flowers.

steps: Integrates both texts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Honeybees live in colonies and communicate with a waggle dance to find flowers.

items.prompt:
Why is it useful to read TWO texts on a topic instead of one?
A) You see what they agree on and gain the extra facts each adds
B) It is always slower and worse
C) One text is always wrong
items.answer: A) You see what they agree on and gain the extra facts each adds

steps: Fuller, cross-checked understanding. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) You see what they agree on and gain the extra facts each adds
